title: Collect roadmap feeder evidence for direct-outreach-v1
description:
Read-only evidence request on scaleup-svr for parent SCAA-8165. Do not restart or modify anything. Capture and post:
1. systemctl is-active roadmap-feeder-live.service roadmap-feeder-live.timer
2. systemctl show roadmap-feeder-live.service -p ActiveState,SubState,ExecMainStatus,ExecMainStartTimestamp and the timer's LastTriggerUSec/NextElapseUSecRealtime
3. journalctl -u roadmap-feeder-live.service -n 200 --no-pager
4. The complete latest live-last-run.txt and the matching latest file under ~/roadmap-feeder/runs/
5. The direct-outreach-v1 entry from /var/lib/agentos-pods/registry.json
6. grep -nE 'decomposition_gap|requirements first|not build-ready|idle' ~/roadmap-feeder/feeder.py
Post raw outputs or a combined receipt. Do not redact operational evidence unless it contains a secret.
